title: Etale descent of finite functorial log blowup procedures
statement: Consider quasi-compact locally Noetherian fs log schemes [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-trf-fs-log-blowup] with torsion-free characteristic group completions. Suppose a rule $\mathcal T$ is given on the members admitting a global fan chart [lem-trf-log-fan-chart-blowup]. It assigns a finite ordered tower of saturated log blowups with nonempty coherent log ideal centers. Assume that the assignment is independent of the chosen fan chart, and for every strict etale morphism between these members its source tower is canonically the contracted pullback of its target tower. Here pullback recursively blows up pulled-back ideals and contraction deletes only centers equal to the whole log monoid sheaf. Assume that these comparisons preserve centers and order, respect identities and composition, and that the rule is defined also on finite disjoint unions with the same compatibilities for the component inclusions. Then $\mathcal T$ extends, uniquely up to the canonical isomorphisms of contracted towers with centers, to all the indicated fs log schemes, with the same strict etale pullback compatibility. The extension is a finite saturated log blowup tower, and its centers are nonempty coherent ideals. Its contracted pullback to each chart neighborhood is the prescribed tower there.

source.place: Expose VIII, proof of Theorem 3.3.15, pp.109--110, initial descent reduction and final finite-disjoint-union argument; effective gluing input implicit there, using 3.3.8--3.3.10 for log blowups.

proof.text: Use the finite fan-chart cover lemma to choose $u:U\to X$ with charted admissible double and triple overlaps. The synchronization lemma makes $S=\mathcal T(U)$ contracted and supplies an uncontracted center-preserving Cech datum on its one finite ordered index set. Thus the descent input is a single tower, rather than separately ordered towers on individual chart pieces. On the empty input the same lemma gives length zero.

source.place: VIII proof of 3.3.15, pp.109--110; assembly of the separately stated descent lemmas.

proof.text: Apply effective center descent to this datum. It gives a tower $E(X)$ of the same finite length whose full pullback to $U$ is $S$. Its centers are nonempty coherent and proper, so $E(X)$ is contracted; the prescribed overlap identifications are realized at every level.

source.place: VIII proof of 3.3.15, pp.109--110; assembly of the separately stated descent lemmas.

proof.text: For two cover choices $U,V$, their common refinement $W=U\times_XV$ is charted admissible and covers both by the cover lemma. Synchronization detects proper centers on these surjective pullbacks, so neither full tower loses a stage. The prescribed comparisons identify both with $\mathcal T(W)$; their compatibility with the descent data follows from the original composition law on $W\times_XW$. Cover rigidity therefore gives the unique comparison of the descended towers and its cocycle law. On a charted input the identity cover returns $\mathcal T(X)$ with its actual centers.

source.place: VIII proof of 3.3.15, pp.109--110; assembly of the separately stated descent lemmas.

proof.text: For strict etale $f:Y\to X$, use the charted cover $W_Y=Y\times_XU\to Y$ from the cover lemma. Over $W_Y$, contraction of the pullback of $E(X)$ is $\mathcal T(W_Y)$ by the original comparison for $W_Y\to U$; the full pullback of $E(Y)$ is $\mathcal T(W_Y)$ by cover independence. Contraction descent gives $C(f^*E(X))\simeq E(Y)$ with centers and order, including consecutive deletions. For $g:Z\to Y$, the same cover lemma gives $W_Z=Z\times_XU\to Z$. On the charted diagram $W_Z\to W_Y\to U$, the original composition law identifies the composite comparison with the direct one. Contraction descent tests the retained indices and level maps on this cover, proving the global composition law; the identity law is checked with $f=1_X$. This defines the extended procedure and its chart-neighborhood comparisons.

source.place: VIII proof of 3.3.15, pp.109--110; assembly of the separately stated descent lemmas.

proof.text: For any other compatible extension, first contract its whole-monoid stages. Synchronization says that restriction to the surjective chart cover deletes no further stages, so both extensions restrict fully to $\mathcal T(U)$. Cover rigidity gives their unique ordered isomorphism with actual centers. Contraction descent tests naturality on chart covers, where it is the original compatibility. Hence the extension is unique in the asserted sense.
